label: PF Backlog 525
title: EPIC: Security / Privacy / Compliance (CISO view) - posture doc, privacy controls, provable compliance, no false claims
body:
## Problem / why
PF has security agents (security, security-audit), guardrails (PII/injection/secret), secret-scan, a static
high-risk scan, per-agent compliance checks, and NIST-AI-RMF/EU-AI-Act checkpoints - but there is NO single
CISO-level security architecture, no explicit DPDP/GDPR privacy controls, and no machine-checkable compliance
register. A generated-product onboarding template even CLAIMS "SOC 2 Type II certified".

## Goal & value
A CISO-grade posture: one security-architecture doc (data flow, trust boundaries, controls, risk register,
framework mapping), privacy controls (DSR/retention/DPIA/consent), a provable compliance register + gate, and
policy-driven (never false) compliance claims.

## Children
C1 CISO security-architecture doc; C2 privacy controls (DPDP/GDPR); C3 fix the false SOC2 claim (defect/RCCA);
C4 compliance register + gate (framework -> controls -> evidence).
